# OVHcloud — OVHcloud Startup Program

Two levels of free OVHcloud credits: EUR 10,000 with 6 hours of engineer time at Start level, and up to EUR 100,000 with up to 20 hours of engineer time at Scale level, for a maximum of 12 months.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [☁️ Cloud](../categories/cloud.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | €100,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | The FAQ & Support page states participation lasts a maximum of 12 months for each level; unused credits do not extend beyond the program period. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Start (startups) | €10,000 | €10,000 of free cloud credits | No partner needed |
| Scale (scaleups) | €100,000 | Up to €100,000 of free cloud credits | No partner needed |
